list.name: route
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT route FROM requests ORDER BY route
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT route FROM requests ORDER BY route

targets.queryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:00:00Z', ts)) AS INTEGER) * 1000 AS time, COUNT(*) AS requests FROM requests WHERE ts >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND ts <= '${__to:date:iso}' AND ('$route' = 'All' OR route = '$route') GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:00:00Z', ts)) AS INTEGER) * 1000 AS time, COUNT(*) AS requests FROM requests WHERE ts >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND ts <= '${__to:date:iso}' AND ('$route' = 'All' OR route = '$route') GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Visiteurs distincts par jour (hors sondes, indexeurs, nous)

targets.queryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', date) AS INTEGER) * 1000 AS time, COUNT(DISTINCT ip) AS distinct_visitors FROM daily_visitors WHERE date >= date('${__from:date:iso}') AND date <= date('${__to:date:iso}') AND class NOT IN ('prober', 'indexer') AND ip != '169.58.121.36' GROUP BY date ORDER BY date
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', date) AS INTEGER) * 1000 AS time, COUNT(DISTINCT ip) AS distinct_visitors FROM daily_visitors WHERE date >= date('${__from:date:iso}') AND date <= date('${__to:date:iso}') AND class NOT IN ('prober', 'indexer') AND ip != '169.58.121.36' GROUP BY date ORDER BY date

targets.queryText: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'unpaid' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS value FROM requests WHERE ts >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND ts <= '${__to:date:iso}' AND ('$route' = 'All' OR route = '$route')
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'unpaid' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS value FROM requests WHERE ts >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND ts <= '${__to:date:iso}' AND ('$route' = 'All' OR route = '$route')

targets.queryText: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('paid','payment_failed') AND payer IS NOT NULL AND lower(payer) NOT IN ('0xb3f32bdfe8d07825bc0d7387295ab1d7559ba69d','0x3cedc3cba49c3809ee46b9bf60da75d6607b45ec') AND (user_agent IS NULL OR lower(user_agent) NOT LIKE 'python-httpx%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS value FROM requests WHERE ts >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND ts <= '${__to:date:iso}' AND ('$route' = 'All' OR route = '$route')
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('paid','payment_failed') AND payer IS NOT NULL AND lower(payer) NOT IN ('0xb3f32bdfe8d07825bc0d7387295ab1d7559ba69d','0x3cedc3cba49c3809ee46b9bf60da75d6607b45ec') AND (user_agent IS NULL OR lower(user_agent) NOT LIKE 'python-httpx%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS value FROM requests WHERE ts >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND ts <= '${__to:date:iso}' AND ('$route' = 'All' OR route = '$route')

targets.queryText: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND payer IS NOT NULL AND lower(payer) NOT IN ('0xb3f32bdfe8d07825bc0d7387295ab1d7559ba69d','0x3cedc3cba49c3809ee46b9bf60da75d6607b45ec') AND (user_agent IS NULL OR lower(user_agent) NOT LIKE 'python-httpx%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS value FROM requests WHERE ts >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND ts <= '${__to:date:iso}' AND ('$route' = 'All' OR route = '$route')

targets.queryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', date(block_time)) AS INTEGER) * 1000 AS time, SUM(amount_usdc) AS revenue_day FROM chain_payments WHERE is_mechanical = 0 AND block_time >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND block_time <= '${__to:date:iso}' GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', date(block_time)) AS INTEGER) * 1000 AS time, SUM(amount_usdc) AS revenue_day FROM chain_payments WHERE is_mechanical = 0 AND block_time >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND block_time <= '${__to:date:iso}' GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

targets.queryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', date) AS INTEGER) * 1000 AS time, COUNT(*) AS new_buyers FROM daily_visitors WHERE class = 'buyer' AND is_new = 1 AND date >= date('${__from:date:iso}') AND date <= date('${__to:date:iso}') GROUP BY date ORDER BY date
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', date) AS INTEGER) * 1000 AS time, COUNT(*) AS new_buyers FROM daily_visitors WHERE class = 'buyer' AND is_new = 1 AND date >= date('${__from:date:iso}') AND date <= date('${__to:date:iso}') GROUP BY date ORDER BY date

targets.queryText: SELECT route, COUNT(*) AS vues, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND payer IS NOT NULL AND lower(payer) NOT IN ('0xb3f32bdfe8d07825bc0d7387295ab1d7559ba69d','0x3cedc3cba49c3809ee46b9bf60da75d6607b45ec') AND (user_agent IS NULL OR lower(user_agent) NOT LIKE 'python-httpx%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS paiements_reels, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND payer IS NOT NULL AND lower(payer) NOT IN ('0xb3f32bdfe8d07825bc0d7387295ab1d7559ba69d','0x3cedc3cba49c3809ee46b9bf60da75d6607b45ec') AND (user_agent IS NULL OR lower(user_agent) NOT LIKE 'python-httpx%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS conversion_pct FROM requests WHERE ts >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND ts <= '${__to:date:iso}' GROUP BY route ORDER BY paiements_reels DESC, vues DESC
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT route, COUNT(*) AS vues, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND payer IS NOT NULL AND lower(payer) NOT IN ('0xb3f32bdfe8d07825bc0d7387295ab1d7559ba69d','0x3cedc3cba49c3809ee46b9bf60da75d6607b45ec') AND (user_agent IS NULL OR lower(user_agent) NOT LIKE 'python-httpx%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS paiements_reels, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND payer IS NOT NULL AND lower(payer) NOT IN ('0xb3f32bdfe8d07825bc0d7387295ab1d7559ba69d','0x3cedc3cba49c3809ee46b9bf60da75d6607b45ec') AND (user_agent IS NULL OR lower(user_agent) NOT LIKE 'python-httpx%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS conversion_pct FROM requests WHERE ts >= '${__from:date:iso}' AND ts <= '${__to:date:iso}' GROUP BY route ORDER BY paiements_reels DESC, vues DESC

targets.queryText: SELECT ip, user_agent, class, prober_name, SUM(request_count) AS requetes FROM daily_visitors WHERE date >= date('${__from:date:iso}') AND date <= date('${__to:date:iso}') AND ip != '169.58.121.36' AND ('$visitor_type' = 'All' OR class = '$visitor_type') GROUP BY ip, user_agent, class, prober_name ORDER BY requetes DESC LIMIT 50
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT ip, user_agent, class, prober_name, SUM(request_count) AS requetes FROM daily_visitors WHERE date >= date('${__from:date:iso}') AND date <= date('${__to:date:iso}') AND ip != '169.58.121.36' AND ('$visitor_type' = 'All' OR class = '$visitor_type') GROUP BY ip, user_agent, class, prober_name ORDER BY requetes DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Erreurs 4xx/5xx par route publique (periode choisie en haut)

targets.queryText: SELECT route, SUM(c_4xx_other) AS c_4xx, SUM(c_5xx) AS c_5xx, SUM(c_404) AS c_404 FROM daily_route_stats WHERE date >= date('${__from:date:iso}') AND date <= date('${__to:date:iso}') AND route NOT LIKE '/admin%' AND ('$route' = 'All' OR ltrim(route, '/') = '$route') GROUP BY route ORDER BY c_5xx DESC, c_4xx DESC
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT route, SUM(c_4xx_other) AS c_4xx, SUM(c_5xx) AS c_5xx, SUM(c_404) AS c_404 FROM daily_route_stats WHERE date >= date('${__from:date:iso}') AND date <= date('${__to:date:iso}') AND route NOT LIKE '/admin%' AND ('$route' = 'All' OR ltrim(route, '/') = '$route') GROUP BY route ORDER BY c_5xx DESC, c_4xx DESC

panels.description: Source: nginx access log (daily_route_stats, day granularity) - the requests table has no real HTTP status code, only application-level outcomes.

panels.title: Erreurs 5xx des dernieres 24h (avec cause)

targets.queryText: SELECT route, error_reason, COUNT(*) AS n, MAX(ts) AS last_seen FROM requests WHERE status = 'error' AND ts >= datetime('now', '-24 hours') AND route NOT LIKE 'admin%' GROUP BY route, error_reason ORDER BY n DESC
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT route, error_reason, COUNT(*) AS n, MAX(ts) AS last_seen FROM requests WHERE status = 'error' AND ts >= datetime('now', '-24 hours') AND route NOT LIKE 'admin%' GROUP BY route, error_reason ORDER BY n DESC

panels.description: Source: requests.error_reason (application-level cause) - rolling last 24h, independent of the time picker above.

panels.title: Latence p50/p95 par route (ms)

targets.queryText: SELECT route, ROUND(AVG(p50_ms), 1) AS p50_ms, ROUND(AVG(p95_ms), 1) AS p95_ms FROM daily_route_stats WHERE date >= date('${__from:date:iso}') AND date <= date('${__to:date:iso}') AND ('$route' = 'All' OR ltrim(route, '/') = '$route') GROUP BY route ORDER BY p95_ms DESC
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT route, ROUND(AVG(p50_ms), 1) AS p50_ms, ROUND(AVG(p95_ms), 1) AS p95_ms FROM daily_route_stats WHERE date >= date('${__from:date:iso}') AND date <= date('${__to:date:iso}') AND ('$route' = 'All' OR ltrim(route, '/') = '$route') GROUP BY route ORDER BY p95_ms DESC
